citation: Hayes et al. (2017), Tectonic Summaries of Magnitude 7 and Greater Earthquakes from 2000 to 2015, USGS Open-File Report 2016-1192
evidence_used: Covers M7+ Ryukyu events through 2015 including 2002-03-31 M7.1 (usp000b1e2) and 2010-02-26 M7.0 (usp000h7qu).
limitations_and_caveats: Scope limited to M7+ through 2015; excludes post-2015 M7.1 Hyuga-nada event (us6000nith).

citation: Hasterok et al. (2022), New Maps of Global Geological Provinces and Tectonic Plates, Earth-Science Reviews 231, 104069
evidence_used: Surface polygon overlays showing 11 events in Ryukyu subplate, 2 intermediate slab events (usp000jajd, us6000abcq) projecting beneath Yangtze, and 2 trench outer-rise events (usp000hd6j, us7000fszl) in Philippine polygon.
limitations_and_caveats: 2D surface polygons omit NW-dipping slab events beneath the Okinawa Trough and route Ryukyu Trench outer-rise events into Philippine Mobile Belt.

citation: Bird (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems 4(3), 1027
evidence_used: Plate boundary reference for Philippine Sea - Okinawa/Yangtze convergence along the Ryukyu Trench.
limitations_and_caveats: Surface boundary discretization only; does not represent 3D slab contours.

citation: Faccenna et al. (2018), Dynamics of the Ryukyu/Izu-Bonin-Marianas double subduction system, Tectonophysics 746, 229-238
evidence_used: Regional framework for Ryukyu slab dip, Okinawa Trough back-arc extension, and Taiwan/Kyushu end-member junctions.
limitations_and_caveats: Regional synthesis; individual event mechanisms require ComCat detail product verification.
